recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast ink line drawing of five individuals in a tight cluster, rendered with loose, expressive black strokes over a textured, pale cyan background. The composition features a mix of male and female faces with 1970s-style hair, positioned in a pyramid-like arrangement. The top-left corner contains bold, sans-serif typography in a vibrant magenta-pink.
coreVisualRelationships: Black ink line work against a desaturated cyan field
Vibrant magenta text contrasting with the cool-toned background
Overlapping portrait sketches creating a sense of unity and depth
Loose, gestural line quality paired with rigid, geometric typography
coreInvariants: Cyan-blue background with subtle paper texture
Black ink-style line art for all figures
Magenta-pink color for primary text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central cluster of five faces occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central female face looking downward, acting as the focal point of the line art cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold magenta text in the top left, moves down through the sketch lines of the hair, and circles through the various facial expressions.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the top right and around the edges, emphasizing the central group.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background allows the high-contrast black lines and high-saturation magenta text to pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different weights or cases for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Small bird icon in the bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 1970s grotesque aesthetic and weight.
Provides the necessary visual weight and period-appropriate feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a pale cyan textured background with a subtle paper grain. In the center, place a black ink line drawing of five people's faces in a cluster, using loose, expressive, and sketchy strokes. Include a small, faint bird sketch in the bottom left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of bold, heavy sans-serif text in the top left corner. The first line should be large and uppercase in solid magenta. The second line should be smaller, title case, also in magenta.

verificationChecks: Is the line art black and sketchy?
Is the background a pale, textured cyan?
Is the text left-aligned in the top corner?

adjustableVariables: Exact weight of the sans-serif font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Any logos or record label branding
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the line art looks like ink on paper.
Verify the magenta text is legible against the cyan.
Check that the composition feels balanced but slightly top-heavy due to the text.
Confirm the absence of any modern digital artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Black Ink Sketch Portraits] with [Pale Cyan Textured Background] and [Bold Magenta Sans-Serif Typography] in a [Top-Left Aligned Layout].
